With a transparent, open-source approach to password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations, Bitwarden makes it easy for users to extend robust security practices across all online activities. As Product Manager, Platform at Bitwarden, you will own the strategy and execution for deployment optionality: the shared capabilities that let Bitwarden behave consistently and securely whether a customer uses our cloud, a regional or government cloud, or their own servers. You will be meticulous about how each Bitwarden app connects to and is configured for the right place, and about which behaviors are allowed to differ by setup, such as federal security standards (FedRAMP, FIPS), IT-managed device settings, and self-hosting constraints.
